records.jp: あ！　日菜子ちゃん！<CR>ふふふ……
records.en_original: Ah! Hinako! Hehehe...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah! Hinako! Hehehe...
records.en: Ah! Hinako-chan! Hehehe...

records.jp: な、何？
records.en_original: Wh-Why are you laughing?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-why are you laughing?
records.en: Wh-Why are you laughing?

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃんに放課後会えるなんてラッキーだなーと思って！
records.en_original: I'm just happy that I get to meet you after school!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm just happy that I get to run into you after school!
records.en: I felt lucky getting to see you after school, Hinako-chan!

records.jp: （この子……まさか……ほんとに……そういう人なんじゃ……）
records.en_original: (This girl... Don't tell me... Is it like "that"...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (This girl... Don't tell me she thinks of me like THAT?!)
records.en: (This girl... Don't tell me... Is it like "that"...?)

records.jp: しほり。ちょっと聞きたいんだけど――
records.en_original: Shihori. There's something I want to ask you...
records.en_auxiliary: Shihori, there's something I want to ask you.
records.en: Shihori. There's something I want to ask you...

records.jp: しほりってその……私のこと……好きなの？
records.en_original: Shihori... Um... Do you like me?
records.en_auxiliary: Shihori... Um... Do you like me?
records.en: Shihori... Um... Do you like me?

records.jp: うん！　大好きな友達だよ！
records.en_original: Yup! You're my friend, of course I like you!
records.en_auxiliary: Yup! You're my friend. Of course, I like you!
records.en: Yup! You're my friend, of course I like you!

records.jp: いや、そうじゃなくて、<CR>ライクじゃなくて、ラブ？　なのかなって……
records.en_original: No, that's not what I meant... I guess instead of "like," I'm asking if it's "love"?
records.en_auxiliary: No, that's not what I meant. I meant... Like, love?
records.en: No, that's not what I meant... I guess instead of "like," I'm asking if it's "love"?

records.jp: 半々てところかな……<CR>日菜子ちゃんは大切な友達であると同時に
records.en_original: Half and half, I suppose...? I cherish you as a friend, but at the same time...
records.en_auxiliary: Half and half, I suppose? I cherish you as a friend, but at the same time...
records.en: Half and half, I suppose...<CR>Hinako-chan, you're a dear friend, but at the same time...

records.jp: 私にとって特別な人だから……
records.en_original: You're someone special to me...
records.en_auxiliary: You're someone special to me.
records.en: You're someone special to me...

records.jp: 何で？　この学校にはきれいな子やかわいい子はたくさんいるし、<CR>別に私に固執しなくても……
records.en_original: Why? There are lots of pretty girls at this school, there's no need to be so focused on me...
records.en_auxiliary: Why? There are lots of pretty girls at this school. I can't imagine why you'd focus on me.
records.en: Why? There are lots of pretty girls at this school, there's no need to be so focused on me...

records.jp: ううん……。日菜子ちゃんじゃなきゃダメなの！<CR>だって、日菜子ちゃん――
records.en_original: No... It can't be anyone but you, Hinako! Because you're...
records.en_auxiliary: No... It can't be anyone but you, Hinako! Because you're...
records.en: No... It can't be anyone but you, Hinako-chan! Because you're...

records.jp: しほりって……なんで私にこだわるの？<CR>私以外にはそういうことしてるの、見た記憶ないんだけど……
records.en_original: Shihori... Why are you so fixated on me? I don't recall seeing you do things like this with any other girls...
records.en_auxiliary: Shihori, why are you so fixated on me? I don't recall seeing you do things like this with any other girls.
records.en: Shihori... Why are you so fixated on me? I don't recall seeing you do things like this with any other girls...

records.jp: 他の子にもしてるよ？
records.en_original: Oh, there are other girls.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, there are other girls.
records.en: Oh, there are other girls.

records.jp: してるの！？
records.en_original: Really!?
records.en_auxiliary: Really?!
records.en: Really!?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yup.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure.
records.en: Yup.

records.jp: （な、何だろう。それはそれで嫌だな……）
records.en_original: (Wh-What is this? I don't like this answer, either...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Wh-what is this? I don't like this answer either.)
records.en: (Wh-What is this? I don't like this answer, either...)

records.jp: あれ？　もしかして嫉妬してくれてる？
records.en_original: Oh? Are you getting jealous?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh? Are you getting jealous?
records.en: Oh? Are you getting jealous?

records.jp: してない！
records.en_original: No way!
records.en_auxiliary: No way!
records.en: No way!

records.jp: でも、それならなんで私にこだわるの？
records.en_original: But again, why are you so fixated on me?
records.en_auxiliary: But to be clear, what is it about me?
records.en: But again, why are you so fixated on me?

records.jp: だって、日菜子ちゃん――
records.en_original: Because, you're...
records.en_auxiliary: You're...
records.en: Because, Hinako-chan—

records.jp: この前話したデザイナーの人にとってもそっくりなんだもん！
records.en_original: Just like that designer I talked about before!
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly like that designer I talked about before!
records.en: Just like that designer I talked about before!

records.jp: え！　そうだったの！？
records.en_original: What!? Seriously!?
records.en_auxiliary: What? Seriously?!
records.en: What!? Seriously!?

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yup.
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: （そういう理由だったかー……はあ……）
records.en_original: (So that's the reason... Huh...)
records.en_auxiliary: (So that's the reason? Huh.)
records.en: (So that's the reason... Huh...)

records.jp: どこら辺が私と似てるの？　顔とか？
records.en_original: So, what's similar about us? My face?
records.en_auxiliary: So what's similar about us? My face?
records.en: So, what's similar about us? My face?

records.jp: いや、顔は全然。あっちの方が１０倍くらいきれい
records.en_original: Oh, not at all. She was ten times prettier there.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, not at all. She was ten times prettier there.
records.en: Oh, not at all. She was ten times prettier there.

records.jp: （この子……いつか全力で殴ろう……）
records.en_original: (This girl... I'm going to punch her one of these days...)
records.en_auxiliary: (This girl... I'm going to punch her one of these days.)
records.en: (This girl... I'm going to punch her one of these days...)

records.jp: なんて言うんだろう……。<CR>全体的な匂いというか雰囲気というか空気感というか……
records.en_original: How can I put it... It's your overall air, or vibe, or scent...
records.en_auxiliary: How can I put it? It's your overall attitude, or vibe, or scent.
records.en: How can I put it... It's your overall air, or vibe, or scent...

records.jp: （匂いって……）
records.en_original: (Scent...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Scent?)
records.en: (Scent...?)

records.jp: まあ、とにかく似てるんだよ！
records.en_original: Anyway, you're similar!
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, you remind me of her!
records.en: Anyway, you're similar!

records.jp: （ごり押しした……）
records.en_original: (That's not an explanation...)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's not much of an explanation.)
records.en: (That's not an explanation...)

records.jp: だからさあ、日菜子ちゃん！<CR>私と一度くらいさあ……その……
records.en_original: That's why, Hinako! Will you, at least once... Um...
records.en_auxiliary: That's why, Hinako! Will you, at least once... Um...
records.en: That's why, Hinako-chan! Will you, at least once... Um...

records.jp: 他人には言えないことしてみない……？
records.en_original: Do something with me that we can't tell others about...?
records.en_auxiliary: Do something with me that we can't tell others about?
records.en: Do something with me that we can't tell others about...?

records.jp: え、えーと……。何を……？
records.en_original: U-Umm... Like what...?
records.en_auxiliary: Uhh... Like what?
records.en: U-Umm... Like what...?

records.jp: 言わなくても、わかるでしょ……？
records.en_original: You know what I mean, I shouldn't have to say it...
records.en_auxiliary: You know what I mean. I shouldn't have to say it...
records.en: You know what I mean, I shouldn't have to say it...

records.jp: (この子は冗談で言ってるんだよね……)
records.en_original: (She must be joking, right...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (She must be joking, right?)
records.en: (She must be joking, right...?)

records.jp: その……しほり、冗談はよそうよ……
records.en_original: Um... Shihori, you should quit joking about this...
records.en_auxiliary: Um... Shihori, you shouldn't make jokes like that.
records.en: Um... Shihori, you should quit joking about this...

records.jp: 冗談じゃないよ！　真剣な話……
records.en_original: It's not a joke! I'm serious...
records.en_auxiliary: It's not a joke! I'm serious.
records.en: It's not a joke! I'm serious...

records.jp: ……ごめん。私やっぱり今はまだしほりの気持ち<CR>受け止めきれないよ……
records.en_original: ...I'm sorry. I'm flattered, but don't think I can accept your feelings right now, Shihori...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry. I'm flattered, but don't think I can return your feelings right now, Shihori.
records.en: ...I'm sorry. I'm flattered, but don't think I can accept your feelings right now, Shihori...

records.jp: ……あーあ、やっぱりしおらしくしてもダメだったかー
records.en_original: ...Ah, I guess trying to be sweet didn't help, either, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, I guess trying to be sweet was the wrong approach, wasn't it?
records.en: ...Ah, I guess trying to be sweet didn't help, either, huh?

records.jp: ちょ、ちょっとしほり、演技してたの！？
records.en_original: W-Wait, was that an act!?
records.en_auxiliary: W-wait, was that an act?!
records.en: W-Wait, was that an act!?

records.jp: だって、こうでもしないと日菜子ちゃん<CR>振り向いてくれそうにないんだもん
records.en_original: Well, I didn't think you'd look my way unless I tried something like this...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I didn't think you'd look my way unless I tried something like this.
records.en: Because unless I went this far, I didn't think<CR>you'd ever look my way, Hinako-chan...

records.jp: ごめんね？
records.en_original: Sorry!
records.en_auxiliary: Forgive me?
records.en: Sorry!

records.jp: まったくもう……
records.en_original: Sheesh...
records.en_auxiliary: Sheesh...
records.en: Sheesh...

records.jp: それじゃあ、そろそろ時間も遅いし、私帰るから……
records.en_original: Okay, it's getting late, I'm going home...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, it's getting late. I'm going home.
records.en: Okay, it's getting late, I'm going home...
